periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The long axis of the eye patch is oriented diagonally at approximately 45 degrees, converging toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patch is distinctly oval-ellipsoid, with a vertical height approximately 1.5 times its horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch exhibits a tapered teardrop morphology, with the geometric mass extending significantly below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior margin of the dark band displays a shallow, broad U-shaped curve across the dorsal surface.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark fur covers a high proportion of the upper body, extending from the base of the skull to the mid-thoracic region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the ears is wide, approximately 2.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The upper boundaries of the ears are uniformly convex and rounded.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible sharp, light-colored claws on the paws and distinct yellowish-brown discoloration of the white fur on the neck and lateral flanks.
